data.name: Goa
data.description: Indo-Portuguese heritage, vibrant nightlife, spice plantations, waterfall excursions
data.food_scene: Excellent seafood, Goan cuisine, beach shacks, many vegetarian and international options.
data.safety_notes: Generally safe; occasional petty theft near crowded beaches and nightlife areas.
data.special_considerations: Very crowded and expensive in Christmas–New Year week; respect dress codes in churches and temples.
data.suggested_itinerary: Day 1: Panjim & Old Goa churches; Day 2: North Goa beaches (Baga, Calangute, Aguada); Day 3: South Goa (Colva, Palolem); Day 4: Dudhsagar Falls & spice plantation; Day 5: Leisure, river cruise, shopping.
